context_packets.title: Reporting mandate and basis
required_context: Who is the reporting entity and intended reader?
Report purpose: entity statements, personal finances, fiduciary account, tax, investment performance or administration
Period, currency, materiality policy and issued/unissued status
Declared GAAP, tax, cash or other basis and prior accounting policies
Engagement and approval responsibilities
context_packets.privacy_boundary: Use role labels and document IDs; do not put names or private balances in public search prompts.
context_packets.status: Checklist only; no private family documents collected

context_packets.title: Entity, ownership and authority
required_context: Executed organizational documents and amendments
Dated legal and economic ownership register, including outside investors
Tax classification and elections for each entity
Control, voting, removal and substantive participation rights
Account title, beneficiary and authorized signer evidence
context_packets.privacy_boundary: Separate taxpayer identifiers and signed instruments from the public reference package.
context_packets.status: Checklist only; no private family documents collected

context_packets.title: Banking, custody and transactions
required_context: Complete bank and custodian account population
Statements, confirmations, transaction dates and settlement dates
Bank-feed source IDs, corrected/deleted records and duplicates
Restrictions, liens and third-party access rights
Independent payee verification and payment-approval evidence
context_packets.privacy_boundary: Never provide credentials, signing keys or payment instructions to a public catalogue or unauthorised agent.
context_packets.status: Checklist only; no private family documents collected

context_packets.title: Investment and fund agreements
required_context: Executed subscription agreement, LPA and side letters
Commitment, calls, distribution notices, recall rights and fee terms
Capital account statements and audited financials with period labels
Asset or security identifiers, lot records and ownership percentages
Transfers, redemptions, preferred returns, carried interest and waterfall terms
context_packets.privacy_boundary: Actual private offering and manager records may be confidential; retain entitlement and access restrictions.
context_packets.status: Checklist only; no private family documents collected

context_packets.title: Valuation and measurement
required_context: Applicable accounting or other valuation basis
Valuation date, unit of account and ownership restrictions
Pricing sources, appraisals and manager NAV dates
Subsequent transactions, market conditions and stale evidence
Assumptions, models, sensitivity and independent review
context_packets.privacy_boundary: Do not publish private company models or appraisals; expose assumptions only to authorized reviewers.
context_packets.status: Checklist only; no private family documents collected

context_packets.title: Trusts, estates and beneficiary rights
required_context: Executed instrument, amendments and governing law
Trustee powers, income/remainder interests and beneficiary provisions
Grantor/nongrantor and domestic/foreign classifications with support
Death-date or transfer-date inventory and valuations
Principal/income schedules, distributions, elections and prior accounts
context_packets.privacy_boundary: Beneficiary identities, incapacity, deaths and succession documents need especially limited access.
context_packets.status: Checklist only; no private family documents collected

context_packets.title: Expenses, payroll and shared services
required_context: Invoices, contracts, service periods and benefiting parties
Time records or other documented allocation drivers
Office vs household employer, duties and hours
Payroll registers, benefits and remittance confirmations
Reimbursements, management-fee agreements, disputes and related parties
context_packets.privacy_boundary: Payroll and household details are private; use anonymized service types for source discovery.
context_packets.status: Checklist only; no private family documents collected

context_packets.title: Taxpayer-year evidence
required_context: Taxpayer, entity classification and exact tax year
Prior returns, elections, carryovers, basis and capital workpapers
K-1 and information-return issuer, recipient, period and correction status
Income character, residency, liability allocations and passive/at-risk facts
Filing, extension and payment records; reviewer instructions
context_packets.privacy_boundary: No Social Security numbers, employer IDs or full returns belong in the public source register.
context_packets.status: Checklist only; no private family documents collected

context_packets.title: Debt, collateral and liquidity
required_context: Executed notes, guarantees and credit facilities
Interest, fees, maturity, modifications and covenants
Payment schedule, lender statements and accrued-interest support
Pledged or restricted assets and legal ability to transfer cash
Capital commitments, forecast dates and actual-to-plan differences
context_packets.privacy_boundary: Source discovery requires instrument features, not bank account numbers or wire credentials.
context_packets.status: Checklist only; no private family documents collected

context_packets.title: Property, personal assets and charity
required_context: Title, acquisition/disposal records and entity vs personal use
Property-manager statements, leases, deposits and capital projects
Insurance owner, insured, beneficiary, cash value and policy loans
Charitable entity type, donor restrictions, grant agreements and approvals
Appraisals, retirement beneficiary records and contingent obligations
context_packets.privacy_boundary: Charity, trust and personal ownership must remain distinct; restrict household/beneficiary details.
context_packets.status: Checklist only; no private family documents collected

context_packets.title: State and cross-border facts
required_context: Tax and legal residence for relevant persons and entities
Trust administration, trustee/beneficiary location and governing law
Income source, property situs, foreign accounts and signature authority
Foreign entity classification, ownership chains and treaty eligibility
Reporting year, local-law advice and applicable withholding documents
context_packets.privacy_boundary: Use jurisdiction and role facts for initial search; share actual forms only in an authorized environment.
context_packets.status: Checklist only; no private family documents collected

context_packets.title: Systems, controls and assurance
required_context: System-of-record ownership and data dictionary
Import/export populations, duplicates, corrections and reconciliation totals
Roles, segregation, approvals and audit trails
Vendor contracts, SOC report scope/period, user controls and exceptions
Retention, backup restoration, incident response and AI evaluation evidence
context_packets.privacy_boundary: Never put live secrets or production credentials into examples, logs or reference metadata.
context_packets.status: Checklist only; no private family documents collected
